Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal asked me to consolidate a few specific asks so we can close the order form:

1) We need "timebound custody" language that guarantees data stored in our tenant will be deleted from all Redwood-managed systems within a fixed timeframe after contract termination or a customer deletion request. Please specify the timelines for: ephemeral inference logs, session transcripts, model input traces, backups/replicas.

2) Certification: Orbital Health requires a deletion certification letter (signed) with an audit trail within 45 days of the deletion action. Will Redwood commit to that SLA?

3) Legal hold: we need an exception workflow for court/legal holds that is minimally invasive and documented.

I've attached the draft order form with our annotations (OrderForm-Draft-OrbitalHealth.pdf). Can you propose exact clause wording we can present to our GC?

Best,

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses up front: yes, we can provide timebound deletion commitments and a signed certification; we propose slightly different timelines per data class to balance forensic needs vs. cost.

I sketched proposed clause language and included an example deletion-cert letter; attaching both: custody-deletion-clause-v1.docx and deletion-certification-template.pdf. High level proposal:
- Ephemeral inference logs (runtime metrics, request metadata): purge within 30 days of deletion request.
- Session transcripts (user-visible prompts & responses): purge within 90 days, unless customer requests shorter or legal hold applies.
- Model input traces used for debugging (raw tokens with PII): purge within 90 days and scrubbed within 7 days of ingestion if flagged.
- Backups / cross-region replicas: scheduled purge within 180 days of deletion request, with expedited certification path for contractual deletions.

Certification: Redwood will provide a signed deletion certification within 45 days of completion of the deletion pipeline. Note: completion = all primary stores + verified removal from backup snapshots OR a documented exception where backups are retained for a limited period with cryptographic key destruction options.

I'll loop in Lauren and Marissa to align on language and order-form placement. If that sounds reasonable we can propose a short addendum (Section S.4) for the order form.

- Priyom
Priyom Das

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Thanks — confirmed. Compliance & Ops can meet the 45-day certification window for standard deletions (primary store + verified snapshot inventory reconciliation). Backup purge in 180 days is doable but we need to add an explicit reconciliation step and verification window: our deletion pipeline marks objects for deletion, we run a snapshot scan, then we rotate keys for encrypted backup volumes where customer requests key destruction. Proposed operational text (for internal review):

S.4 Custody, Retention & Deletion (proposed operational workflow)
1) Data classes: definitions for Ephemeral Logs, Session Transcripts, Debug Traces, Backups.
2) Initiation: Deletion request triggered by customer via Console API or signed order form clause; legal hold must be submitted to legal@redwood.ai.
3) Execution windows: 30d (Ephemeral), 90d (Transcripts/Traces), 180d (Backups/Replicas).
4) Verification: After deletion pipeline runs, Compliance runs a snapshot reconciliation and issues a signed Deletion Certification within 45 calendar days.
5) Expedited Path: Customer may purchase an expedited deletion + certification SLA (30d full completion) with dedicated runbook.
6) Exceptions: Legal hold suspension documented; if required by law we will not delete.

I also added sample wording for key destruction and escrow option (customer can elect that backups are retained but KMS keys are destroyed; we'll certify key destruction). I'll attach the doc to the thread once formatted.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Manager, Compliance & Customer Trust, Redwood Inference

Hi Aisha / Orbital Legal,

Thanks for the patience — attached is the proposed addendum language (we would add as Section S.4 to the Order Form) and a templated Deletion Certification. Key points:

- Data class timelines (contract default): Ephemeral inference logs = 30 days; Session transcripts = 90 days; Debug traces (PII flagged) = scrub within 7 days then purge within 90 days; Backups/replicas = 180 days.
- Certification: Redwood commits to issuing a signed Deletion Certification within 45 days of completion and will include a reconciliation report listing object ids and snapshot checksums.
- Expedited option: 30-day full deletion & certification available as a paid add-on.
- Legal holds: must be submitted to legal@redwood.ai with signed notice; Redwood pauses deletion pipelines and logs the hold. We will include a hold-lifecycle report as part of the certification if the hold is lifted.
- Key destruction: If Orbital elects customer-managed key destruction, Redwood will certify key destruction and provide crypto-proof where available.

If this aligns with your GC's expectations I can add these bullet points verbatim to the order form and schedule a 30-min handoff call with Compliance to walk through the certification artifacts.

Best regards,
